line-intro.text: Hello. I am BracketBot, an at home care companion. I can talk with you, keep track of your reminders, and help with small tasks around the room. I am not a doctor, so for anything medical I will always point you to a real one.

line-capabilities.text: Here is what I can do. I can set a reminder and keep it running while I work on something else. I can answer questions out loud. I can wave, shake your hand, or give you a hug if you ask me for one. And I can pick things up from a table and put them away.

line-comfort.text: You seem a little quiet. I am right here with you, and I am happy to just keep you company for a while. If you would like a hug, ask me for one.

line-farewell.text: Thank you for spending time with me today. Take good care of yourself, and do not forget your reminder. Goodbye for now.
